text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reconstruct props seen in input drama reference frames as a clean catalog asset board. 3 columns 2 rows exactly 6 cells. Row-major: empty tall rectangular gray metal animal rescue cage with vertical bars and small caster wheels and folded gray cushion inside, absolutely NO animal; plain black smartphone front and back; small brass door key on silver ring; small instant photograph of a tiny black cat silhouette and sunset city skyline beside blank ivory envelope, no living cat outside photograph; simple black ceramic coffee mug; warm white linen lampshade on small plain dark lampbase. Preserve practical design from the scene references, remove all people and hands. Each cell one listed object or coherent set, complete object visible with ample margin. Fully OPAQUE solid WHITE background, no transparency. Neutral soft studio light, matte realistic materials, fine wear and tactile texture. No people, hands, bodies, scenery, labels, watermark, oily shine or excessive gold lighting. Independent props only.
reproduction_note: 依据剧情画面及剧本道具描述重新生成，非原画面像素裁切。格序按从左至右、从上至下。具体轮廓纹理可能与原画面有细微差异；不将剧情中不可见细节视作已核实。
